name: Discover Model Settings
description: Probe the configured LM provider to discover the value space for reasoning_effort (and recommend the lowest-reasoning value that the model actually honors). Writes the winning settings to sessions/<model-slug>/model_settings.ipynb as a Papermill-parameterized notebook. Used by the agent's RCTG bootstrap to learn per-model configuration the first time a new model is seen.

target_model.description: Model id to probe (e.g. 'google/gemma-4-31b'). Defaults to the currently-loaded model on the provider.
